children: CBOT December corn (CZ26) may break a support at $5.28 per bushel, and fall into $5.22-1/4 to $5.24-1/2 range.
The contract has fallen below a rising channel. The fall confirmed a completion of the bounce from $5.23-1/4. A duplicated channel indicates a target of $5.22-1/4.
Resistance is at $5.30-3/4, a break above which could lead to a gain into $5.33-3/4 to $5.37-1/4 range. On the daily chart, the uptrend from $4.57-1/4 was assumed to have continued.
However, this bullish assumption has to be revised, as the market not only failed to break a resistance at $5.39-1/4, but also pierced below the support at $5.28-1/4.
A break below the support at $5.28-1/4 is likely to be followed by a drop to $5.23-1/2. The drop would confirm the extension of the short downtrend from $5.49-3/4.
